---
title: "Estimation — Mahajan"
---

**Text.** Sanjoy Mahajan, *Street-Fighting Mathematics*.

**Mode.** *Practice mode*, not a sequential curriculum. One problem per low-energy session. Dimensional analysis, easy cases, lumping, pictorial proofs, taking out the big part.

**Why.** Estimation is its own cognitive exercise — different from a Rosenthal proof and valuable for exactly that reason. 30 minutes on a Mahajan problem keeps the *useful approximation* muscle in shape.
